name: windows-appshots
description: Capture a Windows application as pixels plus its Microsoft UI Automation semantics.

interface.shortDescription: Save a semantic AppShot with pixels and accessible text.
interface.longDescription: MCP tools explicitly capture or retrieve a persisted Windows AppShot: a PNG, bounded UI Automation structure, bounded provider-exposed text, and a concise model-readable summary. AppShots are evidence bundles, not live computer-use screenshots or actions.
defaultPrompt: Capture an AppShot of the last Windows app I was using.
Save an AppShot with the current app's accessible controls.
